spec.claim_summary: Long H1 MACD-cross entries taken only when D1 MACD line is above its signal line, ignoring shorts.
spec.untestable_reason: Requires H1 entries filtered by D1 MACD trend, a multi-timeframe condition the schema cannot express and the core of the claimed edge.

claimed.other: Annual return rises to 6.6% (from 4.6%), maximum drawdown improves from –23.9% to –12.4%, the Sharpe ratio increases from 0.33 to 0.80

assumptions: Asset not named in claim text; BTCUSDT chosen as most natural reading.
Execution timeframe is 1h from the stated hourly entry timeframe.
MACD settings not given, so standard 12 fast, 26 slow, 9 signal used.
Claim gives no exit; opposite H1 MACD cross used as closest testable core for exit.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: multi-timeframe condition that H1 long crosses are allowed only when D1 MACD line is above its D1 signal line; H1-only cross is the closest testable core and omits the daily filter which is the heart of the claimed edge.
Claim period beginning in December 2018 interpreted as 2018-12-01; test uses all history with period kept in claimed.

evidence.quote: On the Hourly (H1) timeframe, take trades only in the direction of the D1 trend.
execute long entries only when the H1 MACD crosses upward
